rules.observed_at_utc: OUR collector clock. Never replaced by source_publication_utc.
rules.immutability: Never overwrite an earlier snapshot. Changed bytes => new snapshot_id and hash.
rules.identical_bytes: Dedupe content by SHA-256 while appending observation metadata.
rules.final_pre_release_snapshot: Latest valid snapshot with observed_at_utc < official_release_utc. Post-T0 observations must not become final consensus.
rules.hash: SHA-256 of the artifact bytes actually observed, not of parsed values alone.
